name: Temple of Zin-Malor
summary: The Temple of Zin-Malor is an ancient night elven sanctuary located within the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. Originally dedicated to the moon goddess Elune, the crumbling structure is now held by the Spitelash naga under the direct command of Warlord Krellian.

sections.title: Echoes of the Moon
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering, the Temple of Zin-Malor stood as a grand house of worship dedicated to Elune. Its architecture closely mirrors both the nearby Temple of Arkkoran and the modern Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, bearing the graceful, sweeping stonework characteristic of pre-Sundering night elven civilization. Today, however, its moonlit marble is weathered and broken, overtaken by the serpent-bodied Spitelash naga. These invaders have claimed the holy grounds for themselves, turning a place of quiet reflection into a militarized redoubt.

sections.title: The Stolen Crystal
sections.body: The temple once housed the renowned Crystal of Zin-Malor, a potent artifact that was carried away long ago to Kel'Theril in Winterspring.

faq.q: Who controls the Temple of Zin-Malor today?
aliases: who is the boss in zin malor
faq.answer: The temple is occupied by the Spitelash naga tribe. Their leader in the region, Warlord Krellian, resides within the temple structure itself.

faq.q: What was the temple used for originally?
faq.answer: It was originally built before the Great Sundering by the ancient night elves as a sacred place of worship honoring Elune, the moon goddess.

faq.q: Why does it look so much like the temple in Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Temple of Zin-Malor shares classic night elven architectural roots with the Temple of Arkkoran. The modern Temple of the Moon in Darnassus was deliberately built following this same traditional, sacred layout.

faq.q: What is the Crystal of Zin-Malor?
aliases: where is the crystal of zin malor
faq.answer: It is an ancient magical relic that originally resided within the temple. Long ago, it was stolen away by the residents of Kel'Theril, deep in the frozen lands of Winterspring.

angles.text: Walking the ruins of Zin-Malor offers a bitter reminder of the Highborne era and the tragic corruption of the naga, who now desecrate what was once holy ground dedicated to Elune.
Priesthood traditions honoring Elune run deep in these stones, bearing the exact sanctuary layouts that modern sisterhoods still preserve in Darnassus.
